facts.fact: Radio Tamazuj reports that in Western Bahr el Ghazal State the lands ministry keeps two paper land register books and still issues plot documents the traditional way, with no digitised titling system, and its lands director asked partners for computers and training to digitise.
facts.system: land register books, Western Bahr el Ghazal

SSD.note: Displaced people appear only in land disputes; no registration or digital service stated.
